subject.title: build(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 14 updates

question: Should OpenClaw accept this grouped set of upstream Action revisions for credential-bearing, security-scanning, agent, and release workflows once required exact-head checks are complete?
rationale: CI cannot fully settle behavior in secret-bearing, scheduled, and publishing jobs, and the protected security label requires an explicit owner decision rather than automated cleanup or repair.

options.title: Approve after sensitive-path review
options.body: Review the upstream changelogs for the credential-bearing and publishing actions, wait for required exact-head checks, then merge the grouped pins if no contract change is found.

options.title: Split high-sensitivity actions
options.body: Separate Codex, GitHub App token, CodeQL upload, and Docker publishing updates into narrower PRs if maintainers want isolated rollout and rollback.

recommendation.title: Approve after sensitive-path review
recommendation.body: Review the upstream changelogs for the credential-bearing and publishing actions, wait for required exact-head checks, then merge the grouped pins if no contract change is found.
